Helix site status

Every site Helix can scan, checked once a day. Last check: .

What the states mean

proven
A real account was found and a made-up name was not.
answers
A made-up name got a clear "no such user". No test account is listed for the site, or the listed one was not found.
blocked
The site refused the checker's network (bot check, HTTP 401 or 403, rate limit). It may work from yours. Never switched off for this.
dead
The host name does not resolve, the certificate is invalid, the connection fails or times out, or the server answers 5xx.
broken
The rule reported an account for a made-up name, so it cannot tell names apart.
unknown
Anything else, such as a host the checker itself could not reach.

A site that is dead or broken on 3 checks in a row is switched off: scans leave it out and say how many sites they left out. The first check that finds it working switches it back on. The check runs from one network, so "dead" means dead from there. --include-off scans switched-off sites anyway.
